title: Power Rangers Season 24 Ninja Steel
description: An evil Galvanax tries to take over the galaxy with the help of his minions. However, the Power Rangers try to defy him to save Earth from destruction.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Ninja Steel 24x1
episodes_data.description: A young teen named Brody escapes to Earth from an alien spaceship with a special artifact called the Ninja Nexus Prism. He and two new friends must unlock its secrets to defend it from the villainous champion Galvanax.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Ninja Steel 24x2
episodes_data.description: As Brody, Preston and Sarah return to Brody's childhood home in an attempt to find his lost family, Hayley and Calvin come across a strange alien named Mick.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Ninja Steel 24x3
episodes_data.description: Brody is accused of cheating on his first day of school after using his Data Comm to find answers. Now, he must use his own abilities and leadership skills to lead the Rangers against another threat from Galvanax.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Ninja Steel 24x4
episodes_data.description: Preston is amazed to discover that he has developed real magical abilities; Galvanax hatches a plan with a new monster to steal the ninja power stars.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Ninja Steel 24x5
episodes_data.description: When the Power Rangers are caught in the spider web prison of Galvanax's latest monster, Tangleweb, Calvin must conquer his fear to unlock a new power and save them.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Ninja Steel 24x6
episodes_data.description: Hayley is targeted by Galvanax’s latest monster. Isolated from the other Rangers, she and Redbot must work together to save themselves.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Ninja Steel 24x7
episodes_data.description: Determined to take part in as many student activities as she can, Sarah builds a device that allows her to clone herself, but the plan backfires when Galvanax's monster steals the technology for himself!

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Ninja Steel 24x8
episodes_data.description: Both the Power Rangers and Galvanax attempt to find more information about the new mysterious Gold Ranger.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Ninja Steel 24x9
episodes_data.description: Levi is excited to be embarking on his world tour, but as mysterious earthquakes start shaking up Summer Cove, he's presented with a tough decision.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Ninja Steel 24x10
episodes_data.description: When Summer Cove's sentimental "Ribbon Tree" is in danger of being cut down by Preston's wealthy father, Preston must learn to stand up to his father to save what is important.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Ninja Steel 24x11
episodes_data.description: Galvanax's latest contestant poisons Brody and the Rangers must make the ultimate sacrifice to save him.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Ninja Steel 24x12
episodes_data.description: The Rangers access a powerful new Megazord formation to battle Ripcon.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Ninja Steel 24x13
episodes_data.description: Calvin finds himself increasingly distracted from his friends and Power Ranger duties when he spends all his time trying to impress his local hero.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Ninja Steel 24x14
episodes_data.description: A mysterious princess and her royal guard arrive on Earth to challenge the Rangers.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Ninja Steel 24x15
episodes_data.description: The Power Rangers band together with a new ally to try and defeat Galvanax's new champion -- but even their teamwork may not be enough.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Ninja Steel 24x16
episodes_data.description: The Power Rangers celebrate Halloween by playing a spooky new board game, but find the stakes bigger than they imagined.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Ninja Steel 24x17
episodes_data.description: Hayley and Calvin's relationship is tested when they both decide to run for student body president.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Ninja Steel 24x18
episodes_data.description: Redbot documents the adventures of the Power Rangers on his new blog, while a cat-like monster attempts to steal the Ninja Power Stars.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Ninja Steel 24x19
episodes_data.description: Preston must confront one of Galvanax's newest contestants after his magical spells backfire on his teammates.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Ninja Steel 24x20
episodes_data.description: While Sarah deals with issues at school, the Ninja Steel Rangers must overcome a force field.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Ninja Steel 24x21
episodes_data.description: Galvanax comes to Earth with a new, seemingly unstoppable plan to defeat the Power Rangers.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Ninja Steel 24x22
episodes_data.description: Sarah teams up with Santa Claus to save Christmas and the Power Rangers from a time-manipulating monster.
